comparisons.name: main-hover-light
comparisons.description: Pointer over the controls of a window that is main but not key, Aqua: the three buttons take their colours back and show their glyphs. Native behaviour that no reference screenshot shows [inferred]; the pixels are the key-window fills.

pixels.note: close fill beside its glyph, --mac-color-window-close, as in a key window
minimize fill beside its glyph, --mac-color-window-minimize, as in a key window
zoom fill beside its glyph, --mac-color-window-zoom, as in a key window
glyph: where the two strokes of the close cross cross, --mac-window-controls-close-glyph [measured in a key window]; 2x only, the 1.1 pt strokes do not fill a 1x pixel
glyph: middle of the minimize dash, --mac-window-controls-minimize-glyph [provisional]; 2x only, the 1.3 pt stroke does not fill a 1x pixel
glyph: inside the upper triangle of the full-screen arrows, --mac-window-controls-zoom-glyph [measured in a key window]
